speech_style: Lesson 1.6.5 handoff delivery v1. One settled adult Filipina female Kore trainer narrates every heading, sentence, dialogue and takeaway in Philippine English. Keep a consistent warm feminine mid-register with natural instructional pauses. Do not act out Gibs or the midwife or switch speakers. Preserve exact words, source attribution, every negation, uncertainty and requested versus agreed action. Finish each sentence and the ending clearly. Names in display remain Gibs and Liza; speech-only aliases are Gibz and Lee-sah. This direction is not evidence of stable timbre or human approval.

beats.text: Liza reports a childcare barrier. Gibs tells the midwife; the last attendance date is unverified. A scheduling conversation is requested.
Gibs verifies the authorized recipient and approved private method. He does not send the form to public chat or an unverified account.
At the meeting, he shares a pattern and scheduling question without identifying households. The individual report stays separate.
The midwife asks about the date. “Not yet verified,” Gibs replies. She acknowledges receipt and agrees to check options and reply tomorrow.
Triads rotate BHW, midwife and observer roles. Report, clarify and confirm the owner and follow-up method; retry the missing part.
The chair acknowledges the summary and agrees to ask the health team about scheduling. Gibs confirms follow-up and tells Liza only verified information. No appointment or childcare is promised.
